The site is Oakridge Tenant Co-operative — Maintenance Ledger & Expenses, a expense-tracker web application for Tenant collective maintenance expense logging.

Owner brief: "Our tenant cooperative manages a twelve-unit apartment building and needs a shared ledger for communal repair expenses. Tenants should be able to log out-of-pocket costs for hallway lightbulbs, winter salt, or plumbing washers, providing date, amount, and receipt vendor. All logged items must persist on the server so the monthly balance total is accurate upon reload."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-15/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Oakridge Tenant Co-operative — Maintenance Ledger & Expenses: the page for tenant collective maintenance expense logging, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #1e293b (ot-slate), #b91c1c (ot-brick), #ffffff (ot-card), #cbd5e1 (ot-border), #f8fafc (ot-bg), #0f172a (ot-text), #64748b (ot-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--ot-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a running total that does not match the listed entries; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Oakridge Tenant Co-operative — Maintenance Ledger & Expenses as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Tenant name", "Receipt vendor", "Purchase category", "Expense amount", "Purchase date", "Expense description").

User journey context: Review the running ledger of building maintenance costs and total collective spend. Fill out the expense logging form with purchase category, vendor, amount, and date. Submit the entry, observe the ledger total update, and reload the browser to verify data.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
